item.title: Pull request #3087 created
item.description:
3051 fn:type-of: records

As proposed, I have droped the record() wrapper in the fn:type-of output.

  • I believe that the output will be self-explanatory enough.
  • It will improve consistency, unless we introduce wrappers for other types, too.
  • The inclusion of the namespace URIs should prevent users from misinterpreting the output.

Closes #3051
